tasks:
    repackage:
        from-deps:
            group-by: single-with-filters
        upstream-mac-kind:
            by-build-platform:
                macosx64-shippable:
                    by-release-level:
                        production: build-mac-notarization
                        staging: build-mac-signing
                default: build-mac-signing
        worker-type: b-linux
        worker:
            max-run-time:
                by-build-platform:
                    .*asan.*: 2700
                    default: 900
        mozharness:
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
